header_sentences: See Deep, Fountain, Lake, Pit, River, and Well.

contexts.text: Let there be an expanse in the midst of the waters, and let it distinguish between the waters and the waters ()... The Knowledges in the internal man are called the waters above the expanse; and the scientifics of the external man, the waters under the expanse. Explained. ( = spiritual things in the Rational and the Natural. AC 3623:2.) ( = memory truths, and the interior truths of faith. AC 9340:3.) AC 9596:end.
These Knowledges (in the external memory) are the waters gathered together to one place, and are called seas (verses 9-10).
Waters, in the Word, = Knowledges and scientifics. Illustrated.
The waters going out of the sanctuary () = the life and mercy of the Lord. ( = the truths which confer intelligence. AC 6502:5.)
To wander to drink waters () = to seek for what is true.
They shall drink their waters in desolation () = spiritual things to which they have done violence.
Water () = the spiritual things of faith.

A flood of waters () = the beginning of temptation as to intellectual things... For waters = especially the spiritual things of man, or the intellectual things of faith, and also the falsities which are the opposites of them. Illustrated.
That the waters (of the Flood) = falsities.
Illustrated. AC 871. AC 877.
Waters, in the Word, in general, = what is spiritual, that is, what is intellectual, rational, and scientific; and therefore also the contrary things...
The waters were strengthened very exceedingly upon the earth () = that persuasions of what is false thus increased.
The waters had receded from upon the earth, in going and returning () = fluctuations between truth and falsity. Explained.
The waters were going and decreasing () = that falsities began to disappear. AC 887.
Waters, in the internal sense = spiritual things, which are truths.
I heard a sound as of many waters. Explained. AR 484:7. TCR 390:2.
Let a little water be brought () = ... that the Divine should let itself down nearer to His intellectual things. Explained.
They found no waters () = no Knowledges of truth.
Waters = Knowledges. References. AC 2967:3. AC 3419.
(Abraham) took bread, and a bottle of water () = good and truth. Explained.
The water was consumed out of the bottle () = the desolation of truth.
The afflicted and the needy seek waters, and there are none () = the desolation of truth. ( = those who long for the Knowledges of good and truth. AC 10227:23.)
Living water () = truth itself.
Rivers of living water (), and living fountains of waters () = truths which are from the Lord, that is, from His Word.
Waters, streams, lakes, and springs of waters () = truths which were for refreshment and joy to those in vastation.
That waters = truths, spiritual, rational, and scientific. Illustrated.
It is spiritual waters that are meant; that is, the spiritual things which are of truth.
(Hagar) filled her bottle with water () = truths thence.
That sow beside all waters () = those who suffer themselves to be instructed in spiritual things.
Bread, and water () = charity and faith, or good and truth.

To draw waters = instruction, and also the consequent enlightenment; for waters = the truths of faith; and therefore to draw waters = to be instructed in the truths of faith, and thus to be enlightened. Illustrated. AC 3094 .
Moreover, the drawers of waters, in the Jewish Church, represented those who are continually wanting to know truths merely for the sake of knowing them, and without caring about any use.
Water = truth. AC 9396:end, References.
Water shall flow from his buckets () = that truths will do so from Knowledges.
Let me... sip a little water from thy pitcher () = an inquiry as to whether anything of truth from this source could be conjoined.
A state of vastated truth, is signified by they shall drink water by measure ().
Water = the Spiritual, thus truth.
Thou that dwellest upon many waters () = in Knowledges about truth.
They found a well of living waters () = the Word as to its literal sense in which is the internal sense... and therefore its waters are called living. Illustrated.
Waters = truths. AC 4697:end.
The waters of Judah () = the truths which are from the good of love to the Lord.
Under Wash, see this reference.
Waters = Knowledges and scientifics, which are the truths of the Natural.
Water = truth in general.
Gatherings of waters, clouds of the skies () = the Word in the letter.
I will sprinkle clean water upon you () = the purification of the heart.
The odour of the sphere (of the thought of scandals about the Lord) was perceived as being like that of stinking water, and of water defiled by filthy refuse.
There was no water in it () = that there was then no truth. Explained.
The staff of water () = support and power by the truth of faith. ( = power from truth. AC 9028:end.) AC 9323:2.
The waters of the lower fish-pool () = the traditions by means of which they have made breaches in the truths of the Word.
Where water, or drink, is mentioned in the Word, the Angels understand spiritual water or drink, namely, the truth of faith.
To give to drink a cup of water in My name () = to instruct, from a little charity, in the truths of faith.
By water and the Spirit = by faith and charity. ( = by the truth of doctrine and the good of life. AC 5342:end.)
He gave them waters () = a general influx of truth from the Internal. Explained.
Thou disturbedst the waters with thy feet () = to defile and pervert the truths of faith by means of the scientifics which are of the Natural.
Waters = the truth of faith.
Light as water () = that faith alone has no glory or Power; for to be as light as water, is to be of no weight or value. AE 434:17.
As the hart panteth after the water brooks () = to long for truths from the affection of truth.
Channels of waters () = the Knowledges of good and truth, which are upon every high mountain... , because these Knowledges flow from the goods of celestial and spiritual love.
Waters, in the opposite, = falsities.
A state of temptation is here described; and the waters which encompassed me even to the soul () = falsities.
Because I drew him out of the waters () = deliverance from falsities; for the waters, here, are those of the river of Egypt.
Take of the waters of the river () false scientifics.
In the wilderness shall waters break out... () = the Knowledges of truth and good.

The second degree (of the taking away of the influx of truth and good) is described by the waters of Egypt being turned into blood (), by which is signified that truths themselves had been falsified. AC 7307. AC 7316. AC 7317. AC 7320. AC 7332.
Stretch thy hand over the waters of Egypt () = the exercise of spiritual power over the falsities which are infesting. AC 7324. AC 7325. AC 7385.
(The waters about the river, which the Egyptians dug for = truths sought by them to be applied to falsities. Explained.)
He goeth forth to the waters () = that from these evils they again think falsities.
Nor boiled with waters () = not... from the truth of faith. Explained.
As regeneration is effected by means of truth and good, it is said, I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and the spirit upon his seed ().
The waters of the great deep, and the depths of the sea () = the Hell where are they who are in faith separated from charity... The waters as of the sea, under which they are, are falsities.
Falsities from evils are signified by the waters which overwhelmed the Egyptians. AC 8137:2. AC 8146.
The waters which separate certain Hells. Explained.
The waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left () = that they were withheld from falsities on every side. Explained. AC 8235.
The falsities which flow out from evils then constitute a sphere around them, which appears either as a dense cloud, or as water.
The waters returned upon the Egyptians () = that the falsities from evil would pour back over them... AC 8229.
By the wind of Thy nostrils were the waters heaped up () = that falsities were collected into a one by the presence of Heaven.
In the vast waters () = whelmed about by an immense number of falsities.
They went three days in the wilderness, and found no waters () = that truths were lacking, and at last utterly.

They could not drink the waters on account of their bitterness () = that truths appeared undelightful to them, because devoid of the affection of good; for to drink waters = to receive truths, and apply them under good. Explained.
To cast wood into waters = to affect truths with good.
The waters were made sweet () = that in this way truths are made delightful.
There were twelve springs of waters () = truths in all abundance.
They encamped there beside the waters () = that after temptation the truths of faith are put in order by means of the good of love. Explained.

In  a fourth temptation is treated of which is signified by the murmuring of the sons of Israel because they had no water; and therefore the truth of faith was given them by the Lord; which is signified by the water from the rock of Horeb. AC 8562.
For as water and drink recreate the natural life, so do truths and the Knowledges of truth recreate the spiritual life. Explained.
The people thirsted there for waters () = an increase of the longing for truth.
The fountain of the water of life () = the truth and good of faith.
The water that I shall give him shall be in him a fountain of water springing up into everlasting life () = the truth of faith from the Word, and thus from the Lord. DSS 2:2.

(Out of his belly shall flow) rivers of living water () = the Divine truth which is from the Lord alone. ( = truths Divine. AC 9818:14.) ( = Divine truth from the Lord in abundance. AE 183:10.) AE 518:22. AE 622:4.
The waters shall come forth from (the rock) () = that the truths of faith are from Him.
The sound (of their wings) as the sound of great waters () = the quality of the Divine truth in Heaven.
A drought is upon her waters () = truths in which there is nothing of life.
In the waters under the earth () = in the Corporeal Sensuous... To this belong the scientifics which arise proximately from the experience of the external senses.
She sitteth upon many waters () = upon falsities.
Come ye to the waters () = to truths from the Word.
The waters are come in unto my soul (; ) = falsities, and also the temptations which are caused by the injection of falsities.
The reason water also came out of the Lord's side () is that water = external truth Divine, such as is the Word in the letter.
To sow beside all waters () = to be instructed in all truths whatever which are of use.
He shall bless thy bread and thy waters () = the increase of the good of love and of the truth of faith.
Bread and water, as used together. Illustrated. AC 9470:2.

The waters are evil () = truths without good. The outlet of the waters = the Natural of man which receives the Knowledges of truth and good. (The waters of Jericho, here = the truths of the sense of the letter. AC 10300:end.)
The water (of the Euphrates) was dried up () = those falsities removed by the Lord.
To drink the waters of Sihor () = falsities which have been induced by scientifics wrongly applied.
The waters of separation and expiation () = purification and withdrawal from evils and falsities by means of truths and goods from the Word.
The truth of the natural man, is signified by the water of the sea. Explained.
Living waters shall go out from Jerusalem () = truths of faith living from the good of love. ( = the Divine truths of the Church from the Lord. AR 238:3.) See AE 275:20.

Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the Kingdom of God (): to be born of water = by means of truth... (Water [here] = the truth of faith which comes to manifest perception in the natural man. AC 10240:2.) ( = the truth of faith from the Word. AC 10388.) TCR 572:2. AE 419:6. AE 475:8. AE 710:10. ( = truth in the external man. TCR 144:end.)
Draw not (thy linen girdle) through water () = ... that the good of the Church was then null, and therefore truths were dissipated... For water = truth purifying and thus restoring.

At the voice which He gives, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens (); voice = the Divine truth; waters = the truths which are in the Heavens and from the Heavens. ( = that from the proceeding Divine there are spiritual truths in immense abundance. AE 644:19.)
Thou shalt put water in (the laver) () = the truths of faith by means of which there is effected purification in the Natural. Explained.
When entering the Tent... they shall wash with waters () = [when in] worship [there must be] purification by means of the truths of faith. Illustrated. AC 10243.
He strewed (the dust of the calf) upon the faces of the waters () = a commingling (of the infernal falsity) with truths.
(While on the mount, Moses) did neither eat bread, nor drink water () = that meanwhile there was no appropriation of the good of love and truth of faith. Explained.
A thin watery atmospheric something.
The voice of Jehovah is upon the waters... Jehovah is upon great waters ()... The great waters upon which Jehovah sitteth = the truths of the Word.
Behold, waters ascending out of the north () = falsities from Hell.
That in the Spiritual World there are waters, etc., but spiritual. General article. DLW 177.
Waters, etc. are mentioned, because these three are the generals... Waters are middle forces...
Blood and water () = Divine truth spiritual and natural, thus the Word in the spiritual and the natural sense. AE 329:16, Explained.
Under Voice, see this reference. AR 614. AR 811.
Waters = truths, in special, natural truths, which are Knowledges from the Word. Illustrated.
When it is known that by waters, in the Word, are meant truths in the natural man, it is evident what was signified by the washings... and by baptism, etc.
He shall lead them to living fountains of waters () = that He will lead by means of the truths of the Word to conjunction with Himself. ( = in Divine truths. AE 483.)
(The star) fell upon a third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters () = that by it all the truths of the Word have been completely falsified. AE 518.
A third part of the waters became wormwood () = all the truths of the Word falsified by self-intelligence. AE 520.
Many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter () = the extinction of spiritual life with many, caused by the falsified truths of the Word. AE 521. AE 522.

They have Power over the waters to turn them into blood () = that those who avert themselves from the two essentials of the New Church, falsify the truths of the Word. ( = that with such, truths are turned into falsities from evil. AE 645.)
The serpent cast out... water as a flood () = reasonings from falsities in abundance. AE 763.
The Angel of the waters () = the Divine truth of the Word. ( = the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom. AE 971.)
The water thereof was dried up () = that the falsities of these interior reasonings have been removed. AE 996.

The great harlot that sitteth upon many waters () = that religiosity... living in the truths of the Word adulterated. ( = that rules over all things of the Word, and thus over the holy things of the Church. AE 1033.)
I heard as it were... the voice of many waters () = the joy of the Angels of the Middle Heaven. ( = the glorification of Him from truths. AE 1215.)

I will give unto him that is athirst, of the fountain of the water of life freely () = that to those who long for truths for any spiritual use, the Lord will give, from Himself, through the Word, all that conduce to that use.
A pure river of the water of life, clear as crystal () = the Divine truth of the Word in abundance translucent from its spiritual sense, which is in the light of Heaven.

Let him that willeth take the water of life freely () = that he who from love wills to learn truths, and to appropriate them to himself, will receive them from the Lord without any labour of his own... The water of life = Divine truths from the Lord through the Word.
Shouts heard as if they bubbled up through water. Explained.
She sprinkled it with the water of the fountain.
Water = natural truths.
Drawers of water = those who suppose that they merit Heaven. Explained.
They desire to punish... by tepid or hot water.
When walking beside waters, (evil Spirits try to throw me in).
(Why Charles XII was made to drink water only.)
See Natural.
On impure and filthy water: its correspondence with self-glorying. Explained. SE 3619.
An aqueous appearance seen in a certain Hell: it represents what is exteriorly sincere.
They then appear encompassed as with waters. SE 4679:end. SE 5827.
Water which was seen to overflow something on fire = falsities.
That waters = the truths of faith, and also the Knowledges of truth. Illustrated. AE 118:3. AE 281:2. AE 433:33. AE 483:2.

The waters issuing out from under the threshold of the house towards the east () = Divine truth proceeding from the Lord, and inflowing with those who are in the good of love to Him. Further Explained. AE 342:7. AE 422:15. ( = Divine truth reforming and regenerating. AE 513:7.) AE 629:8.
Waters = Divine truths in ultimates. AE 419:11.
Its waters cast up mire and dirt () = the falsities from which come evils of life and falsities of doctrine.
Waters = truths and the perception of them.
Mighty waters () = the falsities of evil.
Waters = the truths of the Church. AE 304:51.
Water = truth from a spiritual origin.
Waters = falsities. AE 401:17. AE 405:21. AE 405:42. AE 638:15.
The water of separation = the truth of the natural man.
The great waters () = truths which savour of good and derive their essence from it.
(A land of) rivers of water () = of the doctrinal things of truth.
I washed thee with waters () = to reform and purify by means of truths.
He will lead me to waters of rest () = the truths of Heaven.
Come ye to the waters () = the Word where truths are. ( = truths from the Word for those who desire them. AE 840:2.)
The Lord's making the water wine () = that He made the truths of the external Church into truths of the internal Church...
He turneth the desert into a lake of waters () = that where there is ignorance of truth there shall he abundance of it.
The waters out of the rock () = the Divine truth. AE 444:9.
The strange cold waters flowing down () = falsities in which there is no good.

That he may dip the tip of his finger in water () = in truth from the Word... Thus, to cool his tongue with water = to allay the thirst and cupidity of perverting truths, and of confirming falsities by their means.
In the wilderness shall waters break out () = that truths shall be opened where they were not before.
The waters of the pool of Siloam = the truths of the Word.
A tree planted by the waters () = a man in whom there are truths from the Lord. AE 518:12.
The water that I shall give () = the Divine truth... in which there is life.

In both weeping aloud and shedding tears there comes out water which is bitter and astringent, which is caused by an influx... from the Spiritual World, where bitter water corresponds to a lack of truth because of falsities, and to the consequent grief.
When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee () = that falsities shall not enter.
Their fish shall rot because there is no water () = no longer any living Scientific, because no truth.
That do business in many waters () = those who study the... truth of the Word.
I will pour out waters upon him that is thirsty () = to instruct in truths those who are in the affection of truth.
The voices of many magnificent waters () = Divine truths.

Divine truth from the Lord, the reception of which confers intelligence, is signified by the waters from the rock in Horeb (; ). The rock = the Lord; and the waters that flowed out = the Divine truth from Him.
Waters out of the north () = the falsities of doctrine which are from self-intelligence.

Then the waters had overwhelmed us... then the waters of the proud had gone over our soul (). The waters of the proud = the falsities which favour and confirm the love of self, and also the falsities of doctrine which are from self-intelligence... The waters that had overwhelmed them = falsities, and the consequent destruction of the spiritual life which man has by means of truths and a life according to them. ( = the falsities which inundate... a man when he is in temptations. AE 556:14.)
Whose waters are tossed () = falsities themselves.
That temptations are signified by inundations of waters. Illustrated.
To drink waters () = to learn truths.

The quality of the falsity (there) is Known from the waters themselves; (thus) falsities which are from grievous evils appear over those Hells like thick and black waters; and falsities from the evils of the love of self, like red waters... Truths also appear (there) like waters, but like limpid and pure waters. (For)... those in whom only the first degree has been opened are in an atmosphere which is as it were aqueous, [but] limpid and pure... (For) an atmosphere which is as it were aqueous, corresponds to natural thought and perception; but one which is limpidly aqueous, to the spiritual natural thought and perception in which are the Angels of the Ultimate Heaven; whereas one which is thickly and densely aqueous, and which verges to black or to red, corresponds to that natural thought in which there is nothing spiritual... This is why such Hells are called seas, and deeps.
I will sprinkle clean waters upon you () = to purify... by genuine truths.
He layeth the beams of His chambers in the waters () = that the Lord forms the Heavens and the Church from Divine truths.
The waters of Marah = truths adulterated. Explained.

How intelligence increases through the reception of the Divine truth which proceeds from the Lord, is described by the waters which the prophet passed through (): the waters to the ankles = such intelligence as is possessed by the sensuous and natural man; the waters to the knees = such as is possessed by the spiritual natural man; the waters to the loins = such as is possessed by the spiritual man; and the waters that could not be passed through = celestial intelligence, which is called wisdom, and is such as is possessed by a celestial man, or an Angel of the Third Heaven; which, being unspeakable, is said to be a river that could not be passed through; and because it is far above the natural man, the waters are called waters to swim in. Further explained.
Waters = truths of doctrine.
His branches were multiplied because of many waters () = an abundance through spiritual truths which are from the Knowledges of truth from the Word.
The waters shall fail in the sea () = that there will be no truths in the natural man.
To go into waters () = to weep (thus grief).
To give a cup of cold [water] () = to (act) from obedience; for water = truth in affection; and cold [water] = truth in obedience.
Waters = falsities of faith.
He will bless their bread, and their waters () = the fructification of good and the multiplication of truth... Waters = all the truths of this good.
The staff of water = the truth of the Church.
To drink waters by measure = a lack of truth.
I will make the wilderness a pool cf water, and the dry land into springs of waters () = to fill with truths the spiritual man and the natural man where before there were no truths.
Waters out of the rock of flint () = the truths of this good from the Lord.
The channels of waters appeared () = the truths of the Church overturned.
When a man is in the exercise of charity, the sphere of all his affections and the derivative thoughts appears around him like limpid water...
0 thou that dwellest upon many waters () = the truths of the Word, and thus the holy things of the Church. Explained.
The falsities which are not from evil, may be compared to waters which are not pure, but which when drunk do not lead to drunkenness...

The waters which thou sawest, where the harlot sitteth () = the doctrinal things from the Papal Consistory in general. Explained. ( = those under the Papal dominion, but in the truths of the Word variously adulterated and profaned. Explained. AR 745.)
We drink our waters for silver () = the lack of the Knowledges of truth.

In the opposite sense, by waters are signified falsities; but by impure waters, such as are those of marshes, of bad smelling tanks, of urine, and, in general by all hurtful and death-dealing waters, and therefore by the waters which cause death by inundating.
